title: 2013 Honda Pilot Fender Replacement and Door Molding Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and repaired and painted all four door moldings on a 2013 Honda Pilot.
story: This 2013 Honda Pilot required body repairs along the driver side. The shop replaced the damaged driver-side front fender panel. Replacing a fender is standard procedure when panel deformation prevents proper reshaping or alignment with adjacent panels.

In addition to replacing the fender, all four door moldings were repaired and refinished. Scratches and gouges on the protective trim pieces were sanded smooth, primed, and prepared for color matching to the maroon factory finish.

Once prep work was complete, the new fender panel and trimmed moldings were sprayed and clear-coated. The components were installed to ensure proper alignment and consistent finish along the length of the vehicle.
